in_arabic.name: موشرة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من شورة، يعني المشاركة في الرأي أو المشورة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم موشرة مشتق من الجذر العربي ش-و-ر، ويعني المشاركة في الرأي أو المشورة. يستخدم في بعض الأحيان كاسم للإناث، ويحمل معنى المشاركة في الفكر أو الحوار البناء. وفي بعض السياقات، يمكن أن يشير إلى الحكمة أو الرأي الصائب.

in_urdu.name: موشرہ
in_urdu.meaning: مشورہ دینے والی، رائے کی شریک
in_urdu.long_meaning: موشرہ نام کا مطلب ہے مشورہ دینے والی یا رائے کی شریک۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ ش-و-ر سے ماخوذ ہے، جو مشورہ یا رائے دینے کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشرے میں، یہ نام اکثر ان خواتین کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو حکمت مند اور رائے کی شریک ہوتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मोशिरा
in_hindi.meaning: सलाह देने वाली, राय की साथी
in_hindi.long_meaning: मोशिरा नाम का अर्थ है सलाह देने वाली या राय की साथी। यह नाम अरबी मूल श-व-र से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सलाह या राय देना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अक्सर उन महिलाओं के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो बुद्धिमान और सलाह देने में सक्षम होती हैं।

in_pashto.name: موشره
in_pashto.meaning: د مشورې ورکړې، د راي شريک
in_pashto.long_meaning: موشره نوم د مشورې ورکړې او يا د راي شريک معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي جڑ ش-و-ر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د مشورې يا راي ورکړې معنی لري. د افغان او پښتون دود، دا نوم اکثراً د هغو ښځو لپاره کارول کيږي کومې چې حکمت مندې او د راي شريکې دي.

in_english.name: Mushira
in_english.meaning: one who gives counsel or advice
in_english.long_meaning: Mushira is derived from the Arabic root ش-و-ر (sh-w-r), which means to give counsel or advice. The name signifies a person, typically a woman, who participates in decision-making processes, offers guidance, and shares her opinion. In Islamic tradition, the concept of shura (شورى) refers to consultation and mutual deliberation, reflecting the importance of community and shared responsibility. The name Mushira embodies these values, symbolizing wisdom, cooperation, and thoughtful communication.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Mushira" holds a rich cultural significance in Islamic tradition, as it refers to individuals known for their poetic and hymnic abilities. Throughout Islamic history, oral and written poetry have played an important role in expressing emotions, preserving cultural heritage, and reflecting the beauty of the Arabic language. In Sufi circles, Musharas, or poetry sessions, have been a popular form of spiritual gatherings, allowing individuals to connect with one another through shared expressions of love, devotion, and mysticism.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Mushira" is rooted in its connection to the art of hymns and poetry as a means of expressing one's devotion and connection to the Divine. The Quran itself contains many metaphors and poetic expressions, and Sufi mystics have long recognized the transformative power of poetic language in facilitating spiritual growth and self-realization. Thus, the name "Mushira" serves as a reminder of the importance of using the gift of language to express the inherent beauty of the Divine, as well as our own inner spiritual journeys. In this way, the name carrier of "Mushira" could be seen as a servant of God, using their poetic and hymnic abilities to not only connect with the Divine, but also to inspire and uplift others through the power of the written and spoken word.
